 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary
Hearing, This Day, Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice K.S. Hemalekha
 Oral Order
The petitioner has approached the Court seeking for the following reliefs:-
a) Issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the Respondent No.3 to consider the
Representation of the Petitioner dated 18.07.2025 as per Annexure-E; and
b) Issue such other order or direction, this Hon'ble Court deems fit to grant in the
facts and circumstances of the case in the interest of justice and equity.
Nc: 2025:Khc:50552 Hc-Kar
2.

The petitioner claims to be the owner of the land bearing Survey No. 70 (old Survey No. 37/2)
measuring 30 guntas, situated at Haraluru village, Channarayapatna Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk,
Bengaluru Rural District.

The said property has been acquired for establishment of an industrial area pursuant to the preliminary notification under Section 28(1) followed by a Final Notification issued by the KIADB under Section 28(4) at the KIAD Act on 25.05.2022.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that though the representation has been submitted requesting allotment of a developed land in lieu of compensation the said representation has not been considered by the authorities, compelling him to approach this Court.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel Smt. Namitha.S on behalf of H.L. Pradeep Kumar submits that the representation of the petitioner shall be considered in accordance with law, within a time bound manner.

5. The said submission is recorded.
NC: 2025:KHC:50552 HC-KAR 6.
The grievance of the petitioner would stand redressed if necessary directions are issued to the respondent nos. 2 and 3.

Accordingly, this Court pass the following:-
ORDER 1. Writ petition is disposed of.
2. Respondent Nos.2 and 3 are directed to consider the petitioner's representation dated 18.07.2025 (at Annexure-E) and pass appropriate orders within (8 weeks) from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this order.
Sd/-
